summary: Modal's Starter plan costs $0/month plus metered usage and includes $30/month in compute credits for Functions and Sandboxes CPU, memory and GPU time, with up to 3 workspace seats, 100 containers and 10 GPU concurrency. The credit recurs monthly rather than being a one-time grant. It does not cover Shared Endpoints: token usage is billed from the first request, even if included compute remains unused. Compute beyond the $30 allowance and services not covered by it are separately billed; review workspace spend limits to cap out-of-pocket charges. No fixed end date is stated for the offer. Claiming requires creating a Modal account via the Get Started flow. Modal’s billing guide requires a payment method on file to use the service. Monthly and incremental usage charges beyond credits may be charged automatically.
claim_steps: Go to https://modal.com/pricing and review the Starter plan ($0 + compute / month).
Click Get Started to create a Modal account and add a payment method; Modal’s billing guide requires one on file to use the service.
Create a workspace — the Starter plan includes up to 3 workspace seats.

Use the $30/month allowance for Functions or Sandboxes CPU/memory/GPU compute. Compute overage is billed; Shared Endpoints tokens are billed separately from the first request and never covered by this allowance.
Review the billing guide and set workspace spend limits before running metered workloads to cap out-of-pocket charges.

social_proof.title: Plan Pricing | Modal
social_proof.text: Starter | $0 + compute / month — "Get started with $30 / month free credit"; features list "$30 / month free credits, 3 workspace seats included".

social_proof.title: Billing | Modal Docs
social_proof.text: At the end of each billing cycle, you are auto-charged for the Modal usage incurred during that cycle (less any credits and incremental usage charges).

social_proof.title: Modal Starter FAQ — Shared Endpoints are excluded
social_proof.text: Free usage of Shared Endpoints is not part of the Starter plan. Tokens are billed from your first request, so they will appear on your invoice even if you haven't used your full $30 of included compute.

social_proof.title: Modal pricing FAQ — included usage scope
social_proof.text: Included usage applies to compute: Functions and Sandboxes, billed by the second for CPU, memory, and GPU time.
